class.name: OcgAISViewcube
class.brief_description: Interactive object for displaying the view manipulation cube.
class.description: ! Interactive object for displaying the view manipulation cube. ! ! View cube consists of several parts that are responsible for different camera manipulations: ! @li Cube sides represent main views: top, bottom, left, right, front and back. ! @li Edges represent rotation of one of main views on 45 degrees. ! @li Vertices represent rotation of one of man views in two directions. ! ! The object is expected to behave like a trihedron in the view corner, ! therefore its position should be defined using transformation persistence flags: ! @code SetTransformPersistence (new Graphic3d_TransformPers (Graphic3d_TMF_TriedronPers, ! Aspect_TOTP_LEFT_LOWER, Graphic3d_Vec2i (100, 100)); @endcode ! ! View Cube parts are sensitive to detection, or dynamic highlighting (but not selection), ! and every its owner AIS_ViewCubeOwner corresponds to camera transformation. ! @code ! for (aViewCube->StartAnimation (aDetectedOwner); aViewCube->HasAnimation(); ) ! { ! aViewCube->UpdateAnimation(); ! ... // updating of application window ! } ! @endcode ! or ! @code aViewCube->HandleClick (aDetectedOwner); @endcode ! that includes transformation loop. ! This loop allows external actions like application updating. For this purpose AIS_ViewCube has ! virtual interface onAfterAnimation(), that is to be redefined on application level.

method.name: AIS_ViewCube
method.description: Empty constructor.

method.name: ViewAnimation
method.description: Return view animation.

method.name: SetViewAnimation
method.description: Set view animation.

method.name: ToAutoStartAnimation
method.description: Return TRUE if automatic camera transformation on selection (highlighting) is enabled; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAutoStartAnimation
method.description: Enable/disable automatic camera transformation on selection (highlighting). The automatic logic can be disabled if application wants performing action manually basing on picking results (AIS_ViewCubeOwner).

method.name: IsFixedAnimationLoop
method.description: Return TRUE if camera animation should be done in uninterruptible loop; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetFixedAnimationLoop
method.description: Set if camera animation should be done in uninterruptible loop.

method.name: ResetStyles
method.description: Reset all size and style parameters to default.

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns size (width and height) of View cube sides; 100 by default.

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Sets size (width and height) of View cube sides.

method.name: BoxFacetExtension
method.description: Return box facet extension to edge/corner facet split; 10 by default.

method.name: SetBoxFacetExtension
method.description: Set new value of box facet extension.

method.name: AxesPadding
method.description: Return padding between axes and 3D part (box); 10 by default.

method.name: SetAxesPadding
method.description: Set new value of padding between axes and 3D part (box).

method.name: BoxEdgeGap
method.description: Return gap between box edges and box sides; 0 by default.

method.name: SetBoxEdgeGap
method.description: Set new value of box edges gap.

method.name: BoxEdgeMinSize
method.description: Return minimal size of box edge; 2 by default.

method.name: SetBoxEdgeMinSize
method.description: Set new value of box edge minimal size.

method.name: BoxCornerMinSize
method.description: Return minimal size of box corner; 2 by default.

method.name: SetBoxCornerMinSize
method.description: Set new value of box corner minimal size.

method.name: RoundRadius
method.description: Return relative radius of side corners (round rectangle); 0.0 by default. The value in within [0, 0.5] range meaning absolute radius = RoundRadius() / Size().

method.name: SetRoundRadius
method.description: Set relative radius of View Cube sides corners (round rectangle). The value should be within [0, 0.5] range.

method.name: AxesRadius
method.description: Returns radius of axes of the trihedron; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetAxesRadius
method.description: Sets radius of axes of the trihedron.

method.name: AxesConeRadius
method.description: Returns radius of cone of axes of the trihedron; 3.0 by default.

method.name: SetAxesConeRadius
method.description: Sets radius of cone of axes of the trihedron.

method.name: AxesSphereRadius
method.description: Returns radius of sphere (central point) of the trihedron; 4.0 by default.

method.name: SetAxesSphereRadius
method.description: Sets radius of sphere (central point) of the trihedron.

method.name: ToDrawAxes
method.description: Returns TRUE if trihedron is drawn; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetDrawAxes
method.description: Enable/disable drawing of trihedron.

method.name: ToDrawEdges
method.description: Returns TRUE if edges of View Cube is drawn; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetDrawEdges
method.description: Enable/disable drawing of edges of View Cube.

method.name: ToDrawVertices
method.description: Return TRUE if vertices (vertex) of View Cube is drawn; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetDrawVertices
method.description: Enable/disable drawing of vertices (corners) of View Cube.

method.name: IsYup
method.description: Return TRUE if application expects Y-up viewer orientation instead of Z-up; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetYup
method.description: Set if application expects Y-up viewer orientation instead of Z-up.

method.name: BoxSideStyle
method.description: Return shading style of box sides.

method.name: BoxEdgeStyle
method.description: Return shading style of box edges.

method.name: BoxCornerStyle
method.description: Return shading style of box corners.

method.name: BoxColor
method.description: Return value of front color for the 3D part of object.

method.name: SetBoxColor
method.description: Set new value of front color for the 3D part of object.

method.name: BoxTransparency
method.description: Return transparency for 3D part of object.

method.name: SetBoxTransparency
method.description: Set new value of transparency for 3D part of object.

method.name: InnerColor
method.description: Return color of sides back material.

method.name: SetInnerColor
method.description: Set color of sides back material. Alias for:

method.name: TextColor
method.description: Return text color of labels of box sides; BLACK by default.

method.name: SetTextColor
method.description: Set color of text labels on box sides. Alias for:

method.name: FontHeight
method.description: Return height of font

method.name: SetFontHeight
method.description: Change font height. Alias for:

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Set new value of color for the whole object.

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Reset color for the whole object.

method.name: SetTransparency
method.description: Set new value of transparency for the whole object.

method.name: UnsetTransparency
method.description: Reset transparency for the whole object.

method.name: SetMaterial
method.description: Sets the material for the interactive object.

method.name: UnsetMaterial
method.description: Sets the material for the interactive object.

method.name: Duration
method.description: Return duration of animation in seconds; 0.5 sec by default

method.name: SetDuration
method.description: Set duration of animation.

method.name: ToResetCameraUp
method.description: Return TRUE if new camera Up direction should be always set to default value for a new camera Direction; FALSE by default. When this flag is FALSE, the new camera Up will be set as current Up orthogonalized to the new camera Direction, and will set to default Up on second click.

method.name: SetResetCamera
method.description: Set if new camera Up direction should be always set to default value for a new camera Direction.

method.name: ToFitSelected
method.description: Return TRUE if animation should fit selected objects and FALSE to fit entire scene; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetFitSelected
method.description: Set if animation should fit selected objects or to fit entire scene.

method.name: HasAnimation
method.description: Returns TRUE if View Cube has unfinished animation of view camera.

method.name: UpdateAnimation
method.description: Perform one step of current camera transformation. theToUpdate[in] enable/disable update of view.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Return TRUE for supported display mode.

method.name: GlobalSelOwner
method.description: Global selection has no meaning for this class.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Compute 3D part of View Cube.

method.name: ComputeSelection
method.description: Redefine computing of sensitive entities for View Cube.

method.name: IsAutoHilight
method.description: Disables auto highlighting to use HilightSelected() and HilightOwnerWithColor() overridden methods.

method.name: ClearSelected
method.description: Method which clear all selected owners belonging to this selectable object.

method.name: HilightOwnerWithColor
method.description: Method which highlights input owner belonging to this selectable object.

method.name: UnsetAttributes
method.description: Set default parameters for visual attributes

method.name: UnsetHilightAttributes
method.description: Set default parameters for dynamic highlighting attributes, reset highlight attributes

method.name: IsBoxSide
method.description: Return TRUE if specified orientation belongs to box side.

method.name: IsBoxEdge
method.description: Return TRUE if specified orientation belongs to box edge.

method.name: IsBoxCorner
method.description: Return TRUE if specified orientation belongs to box corner (vertex).
